points.title: 贵族童年
points.description: 托尔斯泰出生于莫斯科一个显赫的贵族家庭，父母都是贵族后裔。幼年时期父母相继去世，由亲戚抚养。在莫斯科接受了早期教育，展现出对文学和哲学的浓厚兴趣。这段经历让他既体验了贵族生活的奢华，也目睹了社会底层人民的苦难，为他后来的创作和思想发展埋下了种子。
points.descriptionEn: Born into an aristocratic family in Moscow, Tolstoy lost both parents at a young age and was raised by relatives. He received early education in Moscow, showing a keen interest in literature and philosophy. This period exposed him to both the luxury of aristocratic life and the suffering of the lower classes, planting seeds for his later creative works and philosophical development.

points.title: 大学求学
points.description: 托尔斯泰进入喀山大学东方语言系学习，后转入法律系。在大学期间，他开始创作早期作品，并接触了启蒙思想和社会改革理念。然而，他对传统教育方式感到不满，最终于1847年退学，返回家族庄园雅斯纳亚·波良纳，开始尝试庄园管理和写作。
points.descriptionEn: Tolstoy entered Kazan University, first studying Oriental languages and then switching to law. During his university years, he began writing early works and was exposed to Enlightenment ideas and social reform concepts. Dissatisfied with traditional education, he dropped out in 1847 and returned to his family estate, Yasnaya Polyana, to manage the estate and pursue writing.

points.title: 军旅生涯
points.description: 托尔斯泰加入军队，在高加索地区服役。这段经历让他深入接触了普通士兵的生活，目睹了战争的残酷。在高加索期间，他创作了《童年》、《少年》和《青年》等早期作品，以及《塞瓦斯托波尔故事》。军旅生涯不仅丰富了他的生活体验，也深化了他对战争、和平与人类命运的思考。
points.descriptionEn: Tolstoy joined the army and served in the Caucasus region. This experience allowed him to intimately connect with the lives of ordinary soldiers and witness the brutality of war. During his time in the Caucasus, he wrote his early works including Childhood, Boyhood, and Youth, as well as the Sevastopol Sketches. His military service not only enriched his life experiences but deepened his reflections on war, peace, and human destiny.

points.title: 创作巅峰
points.description: 回到庄园后，托尔斯泰与索菲亚·别尔斯结婚，开始了家庭生活和创作的高峰期。这一时期，他创作了《战争与和平》(1869)和《安娜·卡列尼娜》(1877)这两部世界文学巨著。同时，他深入思考社会问题，发展出独特的道德哲学，主张非暴力抵抗和简朴生活。这一阶段的作品和思想奠定了他在世界文学史上的不朽地位。
points.descriptionEn: After returning to his estate, Tolstoy married Sophia Behrs and began a period of family life and creative peak. During this time, he wrote his two greatest works, War and Peace (1869) and Anna Karenina (1877). He also deeply contemplated social issues, developing his unique moral philosophy advocating nonviolent resistance and simple living. His works and ideas from this period established his immortal place in world literature.

points.title: 思想转变
points.description: 托尔斯泰移居莫斯科，经历了深刻的思想和宗教转变。他开始深入研究基督教教义，发展出独特的宗教哲学，批判东正教会的教条化。这一时期，他创作了《忏悔录》、《克洛采奏鸣曲》等作品，并积极参与社会活动，关注农民教育问题。他的思想逐渐转向极端的道德主义和反国家主义，与东正教会决裂，甚至被开除教籍。
points.descriptionEn: Moving to Moscow, Tolstoy experienced profound ideological and religious transformation. He began in-depth study of Christian doctrine, developing a unique religious philosophy that criticized the dogmatization of the Russian Orthodox Church. During this period, he wrote works like Confession and The Kreutzer Sonata, and actively engaged in social activities, focusing on peasant education. His thoughts gradually shifted toward extreme moralism and anarchism, leading to his excommunication from the Orthodox Church.

points.title: 晚年出走
points.description: 晚年的托尔斯泰与家庭关系紧张，思想更加激进。1910年10月，他秘密离家出走，试图过简朴的农民生活。途中患病，在阿斯塔堡火车站停留。在生命的最后几天，他拒绝了教会代表，坚持自己的信仰。11月7日，托尔斯泰在阿斯塔堡逝世，享年82岁。他的出走和去世引发了全世界的关注，成为他一生追求真理和简朴生活的最终象征。
points.descriptionEn: In his later years, Tolstoy's relationship with his family grew strained, and his thoughts became more radical. In October 1910, he secretly left home, attempting to live a simple peasant life. During his journey, he fell ill and stayed at Astapovo station. In his final days, he refused representatives of the church, adhering to his own beliefs. Tolstoy died in Astapovo on November 7, 1910, at the age of 82. His departure and death attracted worldwide attention, becoming the ultimate symbol of his lifelong pursuit of truth and simplicity.

supporter.zh: 托尔斯泰被赞誉为人类灵魂的伟大探索者，他的作品深刻揭示了人性的复杂性和社会矛盾。作为道德哲学家，他倡导非暴力抵抗和简朴生活，影响了甘地、马丁·路德·金等和平运动领袖。他的文学成就达到了前所未有的高度，《战争与和平》和《安娜·卡列尼娜》被公认为世界文学巅峰之作，对后世作家产生了深远影响。托尔斯泰通过作品和行动，展现了艺术家对社会的责任感和对真理的不懈追求。
supporter.en: Tolstoy is celebrated as a great explorer of the human soul, whose works profoundly reveal the complexity of human nature and social contradictions. As a moral philosopher, he advocated nonviolent resistance and simple living, influencing peace movement leaders like Gandhi and Martin Luther King Jr. His literary achievements reached unprecedented heights, with War and Peace and Anna Karenina recognized as pinnacles of world literature, profoundly influencing later writers. Through his works and actions, Tolstoy demonstrated the artist's responsibility to society and relentless pursuit of truth.

critic.zh: 批评者指出托尔斯泰的思想存在严重矛盾：一方面谴责贵族生活，另一方面又无法完全摆脱其影响；一方面主张极端简朴，另一方面却生活在富裕庄园中。他的宗教观点被批评为自相矛盾，对东正教会的批判有时流于表面。在文学上，他后期作品的说教倾向过强，艺术性有所下降。此外，他对女性的态度也受到质疑，作品中女性角色往往缺乏深度，且他对妻子的态度晚年变得苛刻无情。
critic.en: Critics point out serious contradictions in Tolstoy's thought: while condemning aristocratic life, he couldn't fully escape its influence; while advocating extreme simplicity, he lived in a wealthy estate. His religious views are criticized as inconsistent, and his critiques of the Orthodox Church sometimes remained superficial. In literature, his later works became overly didactic, with diminished artistic quality. Additionally, his attitudes toward women are questioned, as female characters in his works often lack depth, and his treatment of his wife became harsh and unforgiving in his later years.

objective.zh: 在历史学界和流行文化中，托尔斯泰被定义为一位跨越文学与哲学边界的巨人。他的作品不仅是文学经典，更是社会变革的思想源泉。托尔斯泰现象已成为文化符号，代表着对传统权威的挑战和对精神自由的追求。他的思想影响了从存在主义到非暴力抵抗的多个领域，成为全球知识分子的共同遗产。在流行文化中，他的形象被不断重塑，从严肃的思想家到追求真爱的浪漫人物，展现了其复杂性和持久影响力。
objective.en: In historical scholarship and popular culture, Tolstoy is defined as a giant who transcended the boundaries between literature and philosophy. His works are not only literary classics but also a source of ideas for social change. The Tolstoy phenomenon has become a cultural symbol representing challenges to traditional authority and the pursuit of spiritual freedom. His ideas have influenced multiple fields, from existentialism to nonviolent resistance, becoming a shared heritage of global intellectuals. In popular culture, his image has been constantly reinterpreted, from serious thinker to romantic figure pursuing true love, demonstrating his complexity and enduring influence.

self.zh: 每个人都想改变人类，但没有人想过改变自己。
self.en: Everyone thinks of changing humanity, but no one thinks of changing himself.

others.zh: 托尔斯泰是俄罗斯的一面镜子，他照出了俄罗斯的灵魂，也照出了俄罗斯的全部矛盾。
others.en: Tolstoy is a mirror for Russia, reflecting its soul as well as all its contradictions.
